reason: Both propose essentially the same poorly grounded intervention: M3-specific 300–350 mm spray distances are not transferable to the i7 and are geometrically incompatible with spraying inside a 120 mm diameter, while longer distance does not necessarily increase particle velocity and may increase cooling, deceleration, and oxidation. A offers a better distance-series experiment, whereas B includes service testing, but neither adequately addresses the stated constraint or establishes a physically sound mechanism.
